Alex M: Heads-up — main CI went red right after the merge for PR #1234. Failing job: parallel-db-integration (matrix job 7/12). See CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4423456789

CI Bot: Build 4423456789 — job parallel-db-integration failed: exit code 1. Log attached.

Priya S: I'm oncall, grabbing this. Re-running job now.

Juan R: :eyes: do we have the failing test name / stack?

Alex M: ```
FAILED tests/integration/test_replication.py::test_multi_writer_race_condition
AssertionError: expected 200 got 500
RuntimeError: Deadlock detected waiting for replica promotion
```

Marta: Looks suspiciously like the connection-pool lazy reconnect change from PR #1234. @Priya can you try a rerun with POD_PARALLELISM=1 to see if it reduces contention?

Priya S: Rerun triggered with POD_PARALLELISM=1: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4423456789/rerun

CI Bot: Rerun queued (job 4423456789-7-rerun). ETA ~2m.

oncall-sre: If rerun still fails, bisect to last green and consider revert. I'll capture node logs.

Priya S: Rerun with parallelism=1 passed. Still fails with parallelism=4. Reproducing locally now.

Juan R: If you can repro, run ./scripts/stress_db.sh --parallel 4 and paste output.

Priya S: Repro confirmed locally with parallel 4. Opening revert PR: https://git.redwood/revert/4423 — marking hotfix and requesting expedited review.

Marta: Reviewing the revert now.

Juan R: Also filing a follow-up test to lock down replica promotion ordering.

Alex M: Thanks — will monitor CI. Please ping if anything blocks rollback.

CI Bot: Rebuild triggered on main after revert. Build 4423457001.

Priya S: All matrix jobs passing with parallelism=4 now. :thumbsup:
